channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: LandCare adds Houston branch, promotes 3
item.description: Eric Owens, Michael Healey and Jordan Rudd have all received promotions in conjunction with LandCare's expansion.

item.title: Coxreels adds roller bracket assemblies for its Challenger Series
item.description: The roller bracket assembly is available only in a 4-way upper roller format, due to the compact size of the Challenger platform.

item.title: Rain Bird launches All-in-One Zone Control
item.description: The Rain Bird AIOZC XAOZ100 integrates flow control, pressure regulation and filtration into a compact control zone solution.

item.title: WorkWave launches AI-powered WAIve
item.description: WAIve allows for overnight optimization of schedules and routes, plus an interactive assistant, serving up real-time insights and recommendations.

item.title: Advanced Turf Solutions acquires Nassau Suffolk Turf Services
item.description: Nassau Suffolk Turf Services has served customers on Long Island and in the New York City area for over 25 years.

item.title: Building the Yardmaster platform
item.description: Yardmaster's Mike Montenaro and Kurt Kluznik believe they've struck the right connection with Unity Partners. Here's why.

item.title: Massey Services promotes Swanson to regional VP role
item.description: Michael Swanson will oversee the region of Greater Houston, South Central Texas, North Texas, Oklahoma and The Villages.

item.title: HydroPoint taps Eric Santos as VP of professional services
item.description: Santos brings 30 years of industry experience, including his most recent role, where he served as founder and [resident of Epic Irrigation Service and Management.

item.title: New platform Legacy Lawns launches with 5 unified brands
item.description: King Green, Purple Care, Georgia Lawngrowers, Coastal Turf and Perm-O-Green are now under the Legacy Lawns umbrella.

item.title: Envu rolls out Horizon Rewards program
item.description: LCOs who enroll in Envu Horizon Rewards before April 1 can receive points on eligible purchases made between January 1 and June 30, with rewards deposited in September.
